import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
data = df.iloc[3:104].copy()
data.columns = ['Age', 'qx', 'lx', 'dx', 'Lx', 'Tx', 'ex']
group1 = data[data['Age'].str.contains('20–21|20-21')].iloc[0]
group2 = data[data['Age'].str.contains('30–31|30-31')].iloc[0]
result = str(group2['Age']) if float(group2['dx']) > float(group1['dx']) else str(group1['Age'])
